codeExample.source:
def factorial : Nat → Nat
  | 0     => 1
  | n + 1 => (n + 1) * factorial n

theorem factorial_pos : ∀ n, factorial n > 0 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [factorial]
  | succ n ih => exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.zero_lt_succ n) ih
